_meta.note: Extends Act II gpus.json. Density tiers per doc 27 D1-D3; prices track market_sX.csv.
_meta.conventions: nominal USD; kW per rack; grounded flag per value

generations.name: Hopper (H100/H200)
generations.source: Act II gpus.json; NVIDIA HGX H100 specs (~10.2 kW per 8-GPU server, 4-6 servers/rack air-cooled)

generations.name: Blackwell (B200 / GB200 NVL72)
generations.source: NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 datasheet: ~120-132 kW per rack, liquid cooled

generations.name: Rubin (Vera Rubin NVL144)
generations.note: Game simplification: Rubin NVL144 is drawn as MID tier (~130 kW class) so retrofit from Blackwell is a cooling/power-trim job, not a rebuild.
generations.reasoning: NVIDIA has signalled NVL144 for H2 2026-2027 at higher rack power than NVL72; exact kW and price unpublished; rack price scaled ~2x GB200 per-rack on 2x GPU packages. Real density 190+ kW is compressed to MID for gameplay (flag F-3).

generations.name: Rubin Ultra (NVL576)
generations.reasoning: NVIDIA roadmap (GTC 2025) shows Kyber NVL576 ~600 kW racks for 2027H2. Price is a scaled estimate, not published.

generations.name: Feynman
generations.note: Flavour only. Appears in headlines/glossary and as a 'next-gen rumor' tooltip; no purchasable SKU, no market column.
generations.reasoning: Named on NVIDIA roadmap for 2028; no specs published. Kept as narrative pressure to make Rubin feel like it will age.

low_to_mid.reasoning: Cooling/liquid loop add on an existing hall; between hosting capex and retrofit shell of Act II

mid_to_top.note: Effectively a rebuild: 800V DC busway, 600 kW/rack liquid, structural.
mid_to_top.reasoning: Designed from D3; ~$6-9M/MW band consistent with Act II greenfield $18.5M minus shell reuse.

density_rules.rack_mw_capacity_effect: MW of site power is fixed; higher tier means more GPUs per MW is NOT true - GPUs/MW rises only modestly (~1.3x per generation via efficiency); density lets fewer racks/less floor space host the same MW. Revenue per MW rises with newer gen via price/hr per GPU x GPUs/MW.

gpus_per_mw.reasoning: Designed; H100 ~1.4 kW/GPU all-in incl. cooling and PUE yields ~700/MW; +15-20% per generation

depreciation_and_obsolescence.rule: A GPU's rent tracks its generation's column in market_sX.csv; when the next gen ships, prior gen renewal index (renewal_*_gpu_index) applies at contract end.
depreciation_and_obsolescence.feynman_pressure: On the quarter Feynman rumor fires, Hopper/Blackwell resale value -3% (flavour, D15-safe).

lead_times.note: Feeds the Chip Lead Times Signal; per scenario CSV.
